- Title                   : 1000 Line Community Project V1.0
- Filename                : 1klinecp.wad
- Release date            : 21/04/2019
- Author                  : Liberation and others
- Email Address           : [redacted]
- Other Files By Author   : Numerous.
- Misc. Author Info       : N/A

Description             : A 34 map megawad made for vanilla Doom 2, made by the community with a strict line limit of 1000 lines.

- STORY - 

You emerge from the ruins of your destroyed home, pistol in hand and in utter despair. The alien hordes have poured all over your once beautiful city and have killed everyone that could not be evacuated in time, it seems your the last human alive.

You look towards the city centre, something appears to be happening there however you will have fight through the city suburbs first. If you can make it then perhaps you can stop the invasion?

-END OF STORY-
